cards.back: In a 45°‑45°‑90° triangle, the legs are equal, so opposite = adjacent.

cards.front: What is the relationship between sin 30° and cos 60°?
cards.back: They are equal: 1/2. Because 30° and 60° are complementary, and [[kw:cofunctions]] of complementary angles are equal.
